hook: You've rephrased the same prompt 6 times and the AI still doesn't get it.
caption:
You've rephrased the same prompt 6 times and the AI still doesn't get it.

Not because the AI is broken.

Because it doesn't know you think in systems.

While you're asking about a marketing strategy, your brain is already three layers deep — mapping dependencies, looking for failure points, building the mental flowchart before you've typed a single word.

Generic AI gives you a neat little 5-step listicle.

You wanted the load-bearing assumptions questioned first.

This is the Systems Thinker problem.

You don't want answers. You want a thinking partner who starts at the structural level, not the surface level. Someone who knows that when you ask 'how should I price this?' you actually mean 'walk me through the second and third-order effects of each pricing model on customer behavior and my margins.'

That context shouldn't have to live in your head every time you open a new chat.

That's exactly what a BootFile is for — it carries your thinking style into every conversation so you stop re-teaching AI how your brain works.

The Systems Thinker is one of 8 profiles we've mapped. Curious which one you are?

Link in bio to find out.
